observations.behavior: Documentation change: removed requirement for stored translation; added note that each dispatched job compiles HogQL and executes Trino SQL; removed stored-translation dependency. No score.
observations.code_quote: Data modeling shadow materialization starts when its feature flag is enabled, the managed warehouse is provisioned, and the organization has a ready Trino target. Each dispatched job compiles its current HogQL in Django expansion mode and executes the generated Trino SQL with bound parameters. Endpoint queries are prepared before compilation. The shadow path does not read stored translation results; the manual translation pass remains available for diagnostics. Compilation errors are recorded as failed modeling jobs.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies that shadow materialization no longer requires a stored translation record; each dispatched job compiles HogQL and executes Trino SQL. This could reduce dependency on translation records and simplify eligibility, but no implementation hunk is supplied to verify the change. No score.
